not_observable.case: tests/unit/test_foundations.py::test_schema_head_constant_matches_migrations: compares the SCHEMA_HEAD constant with the migration head; no command prints the constant, so only the head revision 0011 that init reports is observed

tests/unit/test_foundations.py::test_migrations_clean_downgrade_and_existing: the downgrade to 0001 and the row check after the re-upgrade have no command (no command performs a downgrade) and the runner cannot insert rows into a database directly; the upgrade to head is observed above

tests/unit/test_foundations.py::test_stacks_migration_upgrades_populated_0002, test_subagent_telemetry_migration_upgrades_populated_0004, test_experiments_migration_upgrades_populated_0004 and test_predictor_migration_upgrades_populated_0006: they upgrade databases populated at an older revision, and the runner has no step that writes a database file, so the populated fixtures are not reachable here (the CF-05 fixture databases cover them as a dump comparison)

tests/unit/test_foundations.py::test_foreign_keys_enforced_and_rollback: a foreign-key violation and a rolled-back session are issued through the database session API; no CLI command performs a rejected insert, so the rejection and the rollback are not observable
tests/unit/test_foundations.py::test_concurrent_writers_serialize: several threads write through one database; runner steps run one command at a time, so concurrent writers are not observable
